ntsc.target: The PlayStation 2 port: the boot executable SCUS_976.15 (an ELF with 1,803 named symbols) and the frontend and 20 level modules in the SNR2 .REL format. Functions are accepted one by one through private whole-program gates; there is no qualified compiler or game-wide percentage yet.
ntsc.setup: in games/rac5/ntsc: python3 tools/disc.py verify baserom/SCUS_976.15.iso, then python3 -m unittest discover -s tests and python3 tools/check_repository.py (its README)

build.host: Python 3.12 for the tools, on any system; no qualified compiler yet
